findings.title: Express Service Has Significantly Lower On-Time Delivery Rate
findings.method: Grouped transactions by service_class and calculated mean of binary on_time indicator
findings.limitations: Does not account for distance or destination complexity; may reflect intentional trade-off between speed and reliability

findings.title: Premium Category Has Substantially Lower Margins Than Other Categories
findings.method: Calculated margin percentage for each transaction, then averaged by product category
findings.limitations: Does not account for strategic value of premium products; may reflect intentional loss-leader strategy

findings.title: Universal Stockout Vulnerability Across All Products
findings.method: Aggregated stockout counts from inventory table by product_id
findings.limitations: Stockout severity varies by product; may reflect demand spikes rather than supply failures

findings.title: Regional Revenue Distribution Shows Balanced Market Coverage
findings.method: Summed revenue by region name and calculated percentage share
findings.limitations: Does not account for regional population or market potential; may mask intra-regional variations

findings.title: Customer Segments Show Similar Transaction Volumes with Revenue Variation
findings.method: Grouped transactions by customer segment and calculated revenue sum and transaction count
findings.limitations: Does not account for customer acquisition costs by segment; may reflect different sales cycles across segments
